name: Jianjia Yu
biography: Jianjia Yu is a PhD student at Johns Hopkins University, advised by Prof. Yinzhi Cao. Her research focuses on security and privacy in web and mobile ecosystems using program analysis techniques. Her work has received Distinguished Paper Awards at CCS '23 and S&P '25, and an Honorable Mention at USENIX Security '25. She has discovered over 40 zero-day vulnerabilities and uncovered privacy leaks affecting millions of users across browser extensions and mobile applications.
